name: IMMZD18SPolioBOPVPlusIPV
title: IMMZ.D18.S.Polio.bOPV plus IPV schedule
description:
IMMZ.D18.S.Polio.bOPV plus IPV schedule
Bivalent oral polio vaccine (bOPV) plus inactivated polio vaccine (IPV) schedule

relatedArtifact.citation: WHO recommendations for routine immunization - summary tables (January 2025)
Ministry of Health, Uganda. Uganda Routine Immunisation Schedule; UNEPI, User requirements for SMART Guidelines (library/ of smart-immunizations-uganda)

action.title: bOPV dose 1
action.description:
Provision of bOPV dose 1
Trigger event: Child's birth
Trigger date: "Date of birth"
Create condition: The preferred schedule is to administer the 3 doses of bOPV starting from the minimum age of 6 weeks, with at least a 4 week-interval between doses.

action.title: IPV dose 1
action.description:
Provision of IPV dose 1
Trigger event: Child's birth
Trigger date: "Date of birth"
Create condition: In Uganda the first IPV dose is given at 6 weeks of age.
